title: The Voices That Changed a Generation
dek: In 1970s Casablanca, a handful of young groups traded the radio orchestra for the banjo and the bendir, and sang in the language of the street.

title: The Geometry Inside a Zellige Star
dek: Before a single tile is cut, the pattern is a drawing: one circle, sixteen divisions, a few exact lines.

title: The Scientist Who Refused to Be Forgotten
dek: She did foundational work, then disappeared from the record. A career pieced back together from letters and lab notes.

title: Who Leaves, Who Stays
dek: Young graduates across North Africa are weighing the same question. We asked them how they decide.
